records.name: Sci-Fi Lens Stage
records.intro: Sci-fi story as a shot plan, image and sound, and a review.
records.useScenario: Science-fiction ideation, story and script development, a Director Treatment, director-led boards, sci-fi art and audiovisual design, Shot and Clip enhancement, and a science-fiction director Review of existing assets, video, or a finished film. It can enter at any stage of the work.
records.useGuide: Send one spark, a story, outline, script, storyboard, character art, scene art, prop art, a reference video, a Shot, a Clip, or an existing cut. You can send several of these together. The Skill reads the current progress and continues from what already exists. It does not force a restart.
records.outputContentDesc: Depending on the request: a sci-fi genre read, the core mechanism, story directions, a Director Treatment, director constraints for the boards, Art Direction, director intent for Shots and Clips, or a Director Review.
records.presetPrompt: Use Sci-Fi Lens Stage and start from my story or my materials.

records.name: Niulai Art Style
records.intro: Photos or film frames as rough, clumsy low-poly 3D ox art.
records.useScenario: Stylized remakes of portraits, group photos, film stills, and scenes described in text, as playful images with the rough low-poly 3D texture of Niulai.
records.useGuide: Upload a photo or film still, or describe the scene you want. The Skill keeps the original headcount, blocking, action, clothing colors, and key props, and translates the whole image into the style.
records.outputContentDesc: A low-poly 3D ox-character image that keeps the original composition and relationships, then corrected and refined against the generated result.

records.name: Food Fun Calendar
records.intro: Design favorite foods as calendars in a 2D style.
records.useScenario: Want a favorite dessert, breakfast, or drink as a personal calendar? Upload a photo, or name the food, and get a fresh, soft flat-design food calendar for a month or a year.
records.useGuide: Choose a monthly or yearly calendar, and tell me the year, month, and food. You can also choose food colors or black type. Picture-making, real calendar dates, and frosted layout are completed automatically.
records.outputContentDesc: One high-resolution PNG calendar you can save, share, or set as wallpaper: an oversized flat food illustration, accurate Gregorian dates, and a clear frosted-glass effect with no color cast.

records.name: Paper Portrait
records.intro: Ordinary photo, redrawn with wide margins and paper texture.
records.useScenario: An artistic refresh of casual snapshots, travel photos, and images of people, pets, streets, buildings, and food, turning an ordinary photo into a hand-drawn image with negative space and paper texture.
records.useGuide: Upload one or more photos. The Skill reads the subject, spatial relationships, and key memories, and redraws the composition and visual expression while keeping the original content.
records.outputContentDesc: A 3:4 vertical illustration built on white paper, wide negative space, and a small subject, with a little poetic handwriting, ready to save and share.

records.name: Guofeng Giant Art
records.intro: Chinese-style figures among giant lotuses, petals, objects.
records.useScenario: Chinese-style fantasy images, and miniature figures in giant spaces, such as a game of Go beneath a lotus, a boat of petals, or listening to rain inside a giant cup. Supports reference analysis, prompt writing, a single image, a series, a moving shot, and a multi-shot short.
records.useGuide: Enter one image idea, or upload character and scene references, and say whether you want a prompt, an image, or video. You can specify the figure, action, aspect ratio, and duration. For video, prompts are written for the chosen model and bound to the reference assets. A script is not required.
records.outputContentDesc: A complete prompt, an image or video plan, and, as requested, a single image, a series, a moving shot, or a multi-shot short. Production includes asset roles, real asset binding, and model parameters. Full content and results are shown on the canvas. The Agent gives a short note.
records.presetPrompt: Start a Chinese-style giant-object piece.

records.name: Pixel Game Dress-up
records.intro: A person and outfit as a live-action pixel dress-up video.

records.name: LEGO-Style Short
records.intro: Brick, voxel, or mini landscapes from a scene, then a short.

records.name: Miyazaki Dream Poem
records.intro: Miyazaki's language: a story as original hand-drawn anime.
records.useScenario: Hand-drawn animated shorts, fantasy adventure, pastoral daily life, and coming-of-age stories. Start from an idea, script, storyboard, references, or existing video, and complete directing, a local revision, or a cut review.
records.useGuide: First confirm video ratio and model, then provide a story or references. Either is enough, and both are fine. Say what you want finished. Existing scripts, boards, and assets are reused first. The work advances as needed, and key results are confirmed.
records.outputContentDesc: As needed: a story plan, a director's statement, boards, a Clip packing sheet, character and scene assets, video prompts fitted to the chosen model, and a finished animation. A review or a local revision plan can be delivered alone.
records.presetPrompt: Turn my story into original hand-drawn animation in the style of Hayao Miyazaki.

records.name: Photo to Art Poster
records.intro: Photo above, print below, so the real and the abstract echo.
records.useScenario: Travel keepsakes, portrait photography, life records, and art posters. A person, animal, or landscape in a photo is paired, above and below, with an abstract print drawn from the same subject, so action, color, and emotion echo each other.
records.useGuide: Upload one or more photos, and add a title, palette, aspect ratio, and anything that must be kept. The default is a 3:4 vertical poster, split equally top and bottom. Each photo is output on its own. Photos with a clear subject, a direction of action, and a simple background work best.
records.outputContentDesc: An independent two-zone photo poster. The upper half keeps the original subject and real atmosphere. The lower half restates it with a small subject, wide negative space, lines of movement, and paper-and-ink texture. Multiple photos are matched one to one. A complete prompt can be delivered alone.
records.presetPrompt: From the photo I uploaded, make a two-zone art poster, photo above and print below.

records.name: Nolan Time Freeze
records.intro: One action freezes the world: an opener, a turn, or an ad.
records.useScenario: Short-video openers, a show of ability or an emotional turn inside a story, and product emphasis in advertising. The contrast between a frozen environment and a lead who keeps moving creates suspense, stresses emotion, or catches attention.
records.useGuide: Choose the shot's use and the delivery form, and describe the scene or leave it to the AI. A product ad needs the product name and image, and can add benefits and copy. A story shot can provide relationships and an emotional goal. Aspect ratio and duration can be set. Video has sound on by default.
records.outputContentDesc: As requested: a time-freeze video with sound, keyframe images, or a complete prompt. Ad use includes the product presentation and suggested copy. Story use includes shot, performance, and emotional design. Duration follows the content and the model's capacity, and is not limited to 5-6 seconds.
records.presetPrompt: Make me a time-freeze shot.

records.name: Spielberg Walk-in
records.intro: A person or pet leans in and steals the shot, a surprise.
records.useScenario: Short-video openers, pet comedy, character interaction, and comic beats. Background action is shown first, then the subject suddenly approaches the lens. Occlusion, a focus pull, and a change of expression create the shot-stealing effect.
records.useGuide: Tell the AI who walks into the shot, for example a golden retriever in sunglasses, or provide a reference image. Choose video, a keyframe image, or a prompt only. Describe the background and action yourself, or choose to let the AI design them. Leave a field empty and it will be filled in.
records.outputContentDesc: As requested: one continuous single-shot video, a keyframe of the moment of entry, or a complete prompt. It includes establishing the background, the subject entering, a shift of focus, and a closing action, and it keeps the specified subject and reference traits.
records.presetPrompt: Make me a playful shot of someone suddenly walking into frame.

records.name: White Space Mood
records.intro: A photo or idea as a print: negative space, few colors, ink.
records.useScenario: Art posters, social images, decorative prints, and serial visuals. People, animals, plants, objects, or landscapes are reduced to recognizable contours. Broken lines, coarse halftone, and negative space carry direction of movement and emotion.
records.useGuide: Fill in the request card, describe the image or upload a reference, choose to generate the print directly or to receive only a prompt, and choose the aspect ratio. You can add quantity, palette, text, and anything that must be kept. When revising an existing work, say what to keep and what to change.
records.outputContentDesc: As requested, a complete prompt or an independent still print, in the chosen aspect ratio. Multiple photos are matched one to one. A series keeps one palette and one paper-and-ink texture. Text-free prints are supported, as are experimental posters with a little text. Photo contact sheets, framed mockups, and animation are not added by default.
records.presetPrompt: Turn a photo or an idea into an art print of negative space, limited color, and paper and ink.

records.name: Tarantino Violence
records.intro: Dramatic peaks from suspense, fast cuts, absurd conflict.
records.useScenario: Crime suspense, character standoffs, negotiation games, revealed secrets, black humor, and reversals of power.
records.useGuide: Provide a story, script, or reference material. The Skill first reads each character's goal, the information gap, and who holds control, then applies a Tarantino-style director pass.
records.outputContentDesc: A story diagnosis, a directing plan, a design of power and information, dialogue and staging, and further guidance for boards, Shots, Clips, and a cut review.
records.presetPrompt: Shoot this story with more of the tension of a Tarantino short.

records.name: Candid Snap
records.intro: Name or reference as a paste-ready secretly observed prompt.
records.useScenario: You already have a character name, a persona, or a reference, and want a photography prompt for a secretly observed angle, a blocked camera position, a long lens, or a phone candid. One person or several, original or cosplay, all work.
records.useGuide: Drop a character name, or attach a reference. If you do not say otherwise, it is written with a secretly observed feel. To change headcount, place, clothing, style, or the number of images, just say so.
records.outputContentDesc: A prompt ready to paste into image generation. Each one states camera position, occlusion, place, and light, plus identity, pose, and clothing. Chinese by default. It does not output the image itself.
records.presetPrompt: Make me an image with a secretly observed angle.

records.name: Semi-Realistic Girl
records.intro: Girlfriend-POV semi-realistic anime portrait of adult women.
records.useScenario: Semi-realistic anime portraits in everyday places such as parking garages, elevators, apartments, hotel corridors, late-night streets, and car interiors, with a girlfriend point of view, a date feeling, and a lightly mature sensual mood.
records.useGuide: Choose quantity, setting, mood, and the person, and generate. You can also upload a reference person to lock the character. Outfit, pose, lens, and light are otherwise randomized.
records.outputContentDesc: Several independent semi-realistic anime portraits. Each one designs its own setting, sensual outfit, pose, framing, and light, and the batch stays varied.
records.presetPrompt: Generate a set of flirtatious girlfriend-style portraits.

records.name: Chaplin Walk of Life
records.intro: Ordinary trouble as humor and tenderness in a silent film.
records.useScenario: Stories of ordinary people, social fables, the difficulties of growing up, warmth and healing, and retro comedy shorts.
records.useGuide: Provide a story, script, images, or existing assets, and choose what should be generated. The Skill adapts it as comedy direction, then continues into boards, images, and the short.
records.outputContentDesc: A director's adaptation, a silent-comedy storyboard, character and scene visual assets, single-shot images, a finished short, and the matching image and video generation plan.
records.presetPrompt: Adapt my story into a Chaplin-style silent comedy short.

records.name: Midnight Flirt
records.intro: Flirtatious, slightly tipsy candids of adults at night.
records.useScenario: Bars, karaoke rooms, VIP booths, hotel lounges, and late-night gatherings: adult nightlife candids that are lightly mature, sensual, flirtatious, and slightly tipsy.
records.useGuide: Choose quantity, setting, mood, and the people, and generate. You can also upload a reference person to lock the character. Outfit, pose, lens, and light are otherwise randomized.
records.outputContentDesc: Several independent semi-realistic anime portraits. Each one designs its own setting, sensual outfit, pose, framing, and light, and the batch stays varied.
records.presetPrompt: Generate a set of midnight flirtation candids.

records.name: Ang Lee Undercurrent
records.intro: Tell emotions kept under the surface, with restrained shots.
records.useScenario: Family relationships, Eastern ethics, love held in restraint, conflicts of identity, growing up, and making peace with oneself.
records.useGuide: Provide one spark, a story, a script, or reference material. The Skill first reads the relationships and the hidden conflict, then applies an Ang Lee-style director pass.
records.outputContentDesc: A story diagnosis, a directing plan, character performance, space and shot design, and further guidance for boards, Shots, Clips, and a cut review.
records.presetPrompt: I have a story. I want it reworked in Ang Lee's way of directing.

records.name: Kitano Cool Warmth
records.intro: Everyday absurdity and clumsy warmth, as in Takeshi Kitano.
records.useScenario: Director-led original story shorts, relationships, everyday comedy, and stories of parting. Enter from an idea, script, storyboard, references, or existing video to improve feeling, rhythm, and audiovisual expression, or to review and revise locally.
records.useGuide: Choose aspect ratio and video model, provide the story, then add references. Existing material can be reused directly. State the output you want, or the problem to fix. The Skill gives the directing judgment. Main connects assets, boards, and generation.
records.outputContentDesc: As needed: a directing plan, performance and rhythm design, audiovisual constraints, and review notes. Main organizes key assets, boards, model prompts, and video production. Valid outputs are kept. Stop when this goal is done.
records.presetPrompt: Read my story from Takeshi Kitano's point of view as a director.

records.name: Chen Kaige Fate Art
records.intro: Film a person's fate inside the current of an era.
records.useScenario: Family, growing up, homeland, historical change, and the fate of a person. It strengthens period context, relationships, emotional expression, and cinematic narrative for an existing story or script.
records.useGuide: Provide a story, script, storyboard, or existing assets, and state the target output. The Skill diagnoses the story and gives a directing plan, and can continue into boards, an asset plan, Shots, Clips, and the finished film.
records.outputContentDesc: Character visual assets, scene references, a full storyboard, a style sample, and a finished cinematic short, holding three visual lines: reality, memory, and the pressure of the era.
records.presetPrompt: Shoot my story from Chen Kaige's point of view as a director.

records.name: Swim POV Candid
records.intro: Adult summer swimwear candids, caught as if by surprise.
records.useScenario: Use when the user wants one natural summer swimwear candid, a private travel moment, or a photo from a boyfriend, partner, or friend's point of view. Supports one person, two, or a group, plus reference images for person, hair, clothing, pose, framing, setting, and photographic style, and adult cosplay of film, game, and anime characters.
records.useGuide: State the headcount and the people or characters, and state what each reference image is responsible for. If headcount is not specified, the default is one adult woman. Characters are translated into real-world swimwear. If the original character is younger or looks childlike, convert to adult cosplay aged 21 to 30. Generate only one independent photo at a time.
records.outputContentDesc: One independent candid of adults in summer swimwear. Everyone is in the same place at the same instant, and the action is in progress. The frame includes water, a few traces of daily life, and the feel of a private photo album. No collages, contact sheets, storyboards, multi-panel layouts, or commercial posed shots.
records.presetPrompt: Give me one natural summer swimwear candid.

records.name: Felted Wool Film
records.intro: Ideas and stories as warm, fine felted-wool animation.
records.useScenario: Healing stories, fairy-tale shorts, family content, brand stories, and creative social video. People, scenes, and props become a felted-wool world with real spatial scale, fine fiber, and soft light. Boards, stills, or existing clips can also be designed or refined on their own.
records.useGuide: First choose aspect ratio and video model, then enter an idea, story, narration, or script, and upload character, scene, and other references as needed. You can continue from an existing board or video, and review and confirm by stage. Only the current goal needs to be finished. The full pipeline is not required.
records.outputContentDesc: As needed: a felted-wool visual plan, a story storyboard, character and scene references, video prompts, animation clips, and a composite. Ambience, action effects, and dialogue can be generated with the clips. Continuous narration and a unified score can be made separately on request.
records.presetPrompt: Turn my story into warm, finely worked felted-wool animation.

records.name: Travel Stickers
records.intro: Turn photos into paper-textured travel memory cards.
records.useScenario: Illustrated redraws of travel, city streets, daily life, people, and pets, for travel keepsakes, journal collections, life records, and a series of cards on one theme.
records.useGuide: Upload at least one photo and say whether you want a single card or a series. You can set quantity, theme, and whether to add text. Series mode extends other scenes from the photos. If you do not want new scenes, note that only the original photos should be redrawn.
records.outputContentDesc: One or more independent landscape memory-card images, with a scene illustration above and small memory objects below. A short Chinese title is optional. A series keeps one drawing style, and redraws of photos are distinguished from creative extensions outside the image.

records.name: Wes Anderson Color
records.intro: Place a story inside symmetry, color, and absurd order.
records.useScenario: Story shorts of 1 to 5 minutes, brand stories, character stories, retro commercials, and chaptered narrative, with symmetrical framing, vintage color, dry humor, and precise sets.
records.useGuide: Enter a story idea, a full script, or reference images and video. Choose duration, aspect ratio, and color direction, and the work runs from characters and scenes through boards to video.
records.outputContentDesc: A visual-style plan, character and scene assets, chapter storyboard images, video clips, narration, sound effects, and BGM, and the finished film.
records.presetPrompt: Make me a video in the directing aesthetic of Wes Anderson.

records.name: Wong Kar-wai Mood
records.intro: Multi-angle video with Wong Kar-wai's poetry and fractures.
records.useScenario: Turns a story into cinematic video with emotional tension, facial micro-expression, layered depth, and frequent automatic cuts. No stiff frame interpolation or first-and-last-frame generation. References become fluid, multi-angle video in Wong Kar-wai's fragmented style: time, urban loneliness, step-printing, frames within frames, and inner monologue.
records.useGuide: Send one spark, a story, outline, script, storyboard, character art, scene art, prop art, a reference video, a Shot, a Clip, or an existing cut. You can send several of these together. The Skill reads the current progress and continues from what already exists. It does not force a restart.
records.outputContentDesc: A cinematic storyboard script, character and scene designs, continuous multi-shot video, dialogue and ambience, a stylized score, and the finished film.
records.presetPrompt: Make me a short in the shooting style of Wong Kar-wai.

records.name: Fashion Moodboard
records.intro: Cloth, leather, tape, handwritten notes as a fashion board.
records.useScenario: Outfit inspiration, fashion-design pitches, fabric pairing, styling plans, and fashion content. Colors and materials are taken from the clothes and accessories in a reference, and made into a handmade-collage visual board.
records.useGuide: First upload a clear garment or outfit reference. You can add palette, material, mood, and aspect-ratio requirements. By default the original person, pose, clothing, and accessories stay, with paper, tape, and material swatches added around them. If there is no reference, upload is requested first.
records.outputContentDesc: One vertical fashion material board: the reference look on the left, and 3 to 5 matching material swatches on the right, with natural shadow, tape, and a few handwritten notes. After generation or revision, the result card is shown in the IM thread so it can be viewed directly.
records.presetPrompt: Turn the outfit reference I uploaded into a fashion material moodboard.

records.name: My Image Studio
records.intro: A personal IP from a photo, text, or an existing character.
records.useScenario: Live-action to cartoon, original characters from text, personal avatars, social stickers, and consistent extensions of an existing IP. Actions, outfits, scene images, and campaign materials can be added as needed.
records.useGuide: First set the source of the likeness. For a photo, upload or cite an existing photo. For text, fill in a character description and skip upload. For an existing likeness, cite the character. Only one unclear question is asked at a time. After the plan is confirmed, six candidates are generated. After you choose one, the formal avatar and expressions are made.
records.outputContentDesc: An overview of six IP candidates, a formal avatar of the chosen character, a nine-grid expression sheet, and a short character profile. When tools allow, a 4:3 board is made, and transparent stickers can be exported on request. Photo mode keeps the person's features. Text mode follows the confirmed setup. Later assets keep the character and the drawing style consistent.
records.presetPrompt: Design a personal IP for me. First let me choose a photo, text, or an existing likeness.

records.name: Kinetic Type Studio
records.intro: Styled lettering and motion titles, in eight visual styles.
records.useScenario: Brand names, poster titles, game titles, social motion covers, and short-video openers. Creative type images, short type animation, restyling from a reference, and revision of existing type effects and animation prompts.
records.useGuide: Enter the words to design, choose a style from the cards, and add a reference or custom requirements if you have them. Specify image or animation, aspect ratio, and duration as needed. Missing information is asked one item at a time. After delivery, use the cards to change style, keep revising, or finish.
records.outputContentDesc: As requested: a creative type image, a short animation with a clear motion, or a generation prompt ready to use. Accurate lettering and readable hold time are kept. If a tool is unavailable, the ungenerated part is stated clearly, and a prompt is not passed off as a finished asset.
records.presetPrompt: Design creative lettering and animation for me.

records.name: AI Drama Generator
records.intro: One script, from cast and boards through to a finished film.
records.useScenario: AI short dramas, story shorts, manga-adapted dramas, serialized episodes, and script visualization.
records.useGuide: Upload a script, break down characters and scenes, confirm the storyboard, generate character and scene designs, generate video shot by shot, then composite automatically.
records.outputContentDesc: A script breakdown, character turnarounds, four-view scenes, a storyboard script, camera-move diagrams, storyboard video, score and narration, and a finished short-drama film.

records.name: Script to Film
records.intro: Upload a script, board it, and generate the complete video.
records.useScenario: You already have a short-film script, a micro-film script, or a drama script, and want the written script made into a complete video.
records.useGuide: Upload the script, parse the plot, confirm the storyboard, confirm the generation prompts, generate character and scene assets, generate shot video, then composite audio and the final cut.
records.outputContentDesc: A script analysis, a storyboard, character and scene assets, generation prompts, storyboard video, narration and BGM, and the finished film.

records.name: TVC Ad Director
records.intro: Brand brief to final cut: one professional creative TVC.
records.useScenario: Product launches, brand communication, social ads, and e-commerce homepage video. Use it when you are not yet sure whether to feature the product, build an abstract concept, or move the audience through a character story.
records.useGuide: Upload product or brand materials and tell me what kind of ad you want. Choose a creative direction you like, and confirm as prompted.
records.outputContentDesc: A creative plan, a script, image assets, a shot list, and a complete commercial. You can request changes at any point.

records.name: E-com Visual Suite
records.intro: One set of product hero images and detail-page visuals.
records.useScenario: For new-product listings, visual upgrades, e-commerce detail pages, and full product asset kits.
records.useGuide: Upload product images, add selling points and a visual direction, and the system completes product analysis, visual planning, and the full image set.
records.outputContentDesc: 3 core hero images plus 6-8 detail-page assets: lifestyle scenes, benefit frames, material close-ups, white-background KV images, and spec displays.

records.name: Wuxia Film TVC
records.intro: Live wuxia: open landscape, classical space, natural light.
records.useScenario: For tea and wine, jewelry, apparel, cultural tourism, games, traditional culture, and Eastern lifestyle brands. The product can be the visual core, or characters, a jianghu event, and restrained action can carry a brand story with cultural tone.
records.useGuide: Upload product materials and tell me the wuxia atmosphere you want. Choose a visual direction you like, and production can start.
records.outputContentDesc: Classical wuxia character and scene images, a shot list, and a complete commercial.

records.name: Influencer Seeding
records.intro: Real assets as a credible creator video with reasons to buy.
records.useScenario: New-product recommendations, favorite-find shares, use experiences, and social-platform seeding.
records.useGuide: Upload product images, and fill in the product description, publishing platform, and frame ratio.
records.outputContentDesc: A full script, a storyboard, voiceover, video clips, and the finished film.
records.presetPrompt: Make me a creator seeding video.

records.name: Urban Human Story
records.intro: People and places in a small town or old street, one story.
records.useScenario: For small-town stories, memories of old neighborhoods, portraits of ordinary people, homecoming, family and friendship, urban change, and slice-of-life drama.
records.useGuide: Upload a script, story, or character material, or describe the place, the people, and what happens. After the story premise is confirmed, the system designs characters and scenes, boards the film, generates shots, and finishes the edit.
records.outputContentDesc: A story premise, character and scene designs, a full storyboard, first frames for each shot, narrative clips, ambience with optional narration and score, and the finished urban human-interest short.

records.name: Minimal Tech TVC
records.intro: Pure space, precise materials, structure, restrained motion.
records.useScenario: For consumer electronics, smart hardware, cars, industrial equipment, digital products, and new materials. Show structure and function directly, or express energy, connection, computation, and technical principle through abstract visuals.
records.useGuide: Upload product images and the main benefits, and choose a bright, dark, or structural style. The Skill completes the rest of production step by step.
records.outputContentDesc: High-finish product images, structural reveals, a shot list, and a technology commercial.

records.name: 5-Min Film Director
records.intro: A 2-5 minute story, from script and assets to the final cut.
records.useScenario: For continuous story videos of 2 to 5 minutes. Start from an idea, or bring a script, storyboard, or existing assets. It holds characters, wardrobe, props, scenes, and spatial relationships, and controls shot rhythm, dialogue length, action continuity, batch generation, and final assembly. A standalone short or a single still is not the main use.
records.useGuide: Say directly, Make me a 3-minute video, or upload a script and state style, aspect ratio, and target duration. The Skill first confirms the story direction, then organizes the script, an asset list, split storyboards, reference images, and video prompts.
records.outputContentDesc: A full script, a shot list, character, scene, and prop references, and a finished long video assembled in the correct order.

records.name: Cast & Scene Swap
records.intro: Keep the camera and action, then swap people and places.
records.useScenario: Short-video face swap, character replacement, full-body replacement, background replacement, role insertion, and remixes of an existing film.
records.useGuide: Upload the original video and character or scene references. Choose face swap, person swap, background swap, or a combination. The AI reads the original boards and camera, replaces each shot, and keeps the original action, rhythm, and color.
records.outputContentDesc: An original-film storyboard analysis, a reference analysis, shot-by-shot replacement video, a replacement quality check, and the finished video.

records.name: Product Visual TVC
records.intro: The product leads: material, structure, and state changes.
records.useScenario: For consumer electronics, beauty, cars, home appliances, jewelry, packaging, and industrial design, where product texture is the point. Especially when character story should recede and form, material, craft, function, and state of use should lead.
records.useGuide: Upload product images and tell me which benefits matter most. Choose a creative direction you like, and production can start.
records.outputContentDesc: Image assets that emphasize form, material, and function, a shot list, and the finished commercial.

records.name: Dark Eastern Myth
records.intro: Generate dark Eastern-fantasy shorts in a Black Myth style.
records.useScenario: For myth adaptations, god-and-demon battles, ruined temples, monster bosses, Eastern fantasy combat, and game-like CG shorts.
records.useGuide: Enter a plot or idea, or upload character and scene references. The Skill designs characters, scenes, boards, and fight shots together, then generates the full short.
records.outputContentDesc: Character designs, scene references, a storyboard plan, shot videos, and the finished film.

records.name: Avatar Live Selling
records.intro: Natural digital-human talking heads for product promotion.
records.useScenario: E-commerce selling, product introduction, brand seeding, live-stream clips, and social ads.
records.useGuide: Upload a product image and provide selling points or a spoken script. Generate the avatar and a fixed set, record the voice, drive lip sync and performance, and output a complete talking-head video.
records.outputContentDesc: An avatar portrait, product-display keyframes, a spoken script, voice audio, and a 9:16 product talking-head video.

records.name: 3D Guofeng Drama
records.intro: Turn a script into a 3D Chinese costume drama short.
records.useScenario: For costume romance, court intrigue, wuxia, mystery, palace drama, and xianxia story shorts, and for turning a novel, outline, or existing script into 3D Chinese-animation video.
records.useGuide: Upload a script, novel, outline, or existing character and scene assets, or start from a story idea. After script, cast, and sets are confirmed, the system boards, designs characters and scenes, generates each shot, and finishes the edit.
records.outputContentDesc: Script analysis and revision notes, character designs, four-view scenes, key props, a full storyboard, shot-by-shot 3D costume video, character voice and BGM, and a finished 16:9 short drama.

records.name: Drama Visual Pack
records.intro: From a script: cast, sets, and a full preproduction pack.
records.useScenario: Short-drama greenlight, early pitches, visual tone, shoot prep, and cross-team production communication.
records.useGuide: Upload a script or storyboard. After the visual style is confirmed, characters, scenes, props, and key shots are broken down, and a full preproduction visual plan is generated step by step.
records.outputContentDesc: Character, scene, and prop designs, hair-makeup-wardrobe boards, keyframes and mood boards, a color system, poster KVs, a shot list, a visual-direction document, a PPT pitch gallery, and a 3-5 shot concept sample.

records.name: Full IP Character
records.intro: Build one consistent IP character and a full commercial kit.
records.useScenario: For original IPs, brand mascots, designer-toy characters, and content-account identities. Also for extending an existing character into stickers, blind boxes, merchandise, posters, and material variants.
records.useGuide: Upload a character reference, or describe form, personality, and primary color. Generate a character file and a standard turnaround. Confirm the look, or point to what should change. Pick from eight material types, and add channel, size, quantity, or theme. Later assets follow that turnaround. The Skill then generates, checks, and delivers the work.
records.outputContentDesc: A character file and a standard turnaround, plus optional figure nine-grids, sticker sets, outfit series, miniature scenes, concept posters, merchandise mockups, material blind boxes, and material-extension sheets.
records.presetPrompt: Please complete an IP character design and extend it into commercial materials.

records.name: Story-Driven TVC
records.intro: A story TVC: people, events, an emotional turn, the product.
records.useScenario: For food and drink, lifestyle, sport, mother-and-baby, travel, home, and holiday marketing that needs emotional resonance. Especially when a real slice of life, a relationship, or a change of events should carry the product's value.
records.useGuide: Tell me the product, the audience, and the emotion you want. Choose a story direction you like, and production can continue.
records.outputContentDesc: A complete brand story, character and scene images, a shot list, and the finished commercial.

records.name: Healing Life Vlog
records.intro: Turn ordinary days into a gentle, healing life short.
records.useScenario: Living alone, home life, cooking and coffee, rainy days indoors, bedtime notes, and serialized daily vlogs.
records.useGuide: Choose a theme and art style, and upload character or scene references if you have them. Generate the character and living spaces, design a daily storyboard, then generate the vlog.
records.outputContentDesc: Character designs, scene designs, a vlog storyboard, single-episode or serialized healing shorts, and matching BGM.

records.name: Full Brand VI Design
records.intro: A logo, brand visuals, and a commercial kit in one flow.
records.useScenario: For creating a new brand from zero, refreshing an existing visual system, or unifying commercial materials. Also for products, stores, e-commerce, and content brands that need a full identity quickly.
records.useGuide: Start with a brand name plus industry or product type. You can also upload an existing logo, product shots, or references, and add positioning, audience, palette, or style. After the visual direction and logo are confirmed, the rest of the brand system is extended automatically.
records.outputContentDesc: Brand logo, VI guidelines, palette and type direction, social templates, packaging and collateral mockups, a brand IP, and a logo motion. Can extend to an IP 3D model, store and space design, brand posters, and lifestyle marketing images.
records.presetPrompt: Please complete a full brand VI design for me.

records.name: Xianxia Fight Clip
records.intro: Upgrade an ordinary fight into high-impact xianxia combat.
records.useScenario: Xianxia short dramas, Chinese animated series, cultivation duels, magic-weapon combat, awakening reversals, chase rescues, and array-breaking escapes.
records.useGuide: Enter a story idea or script, or upload a raw fight clip, plus character, scene, weapon, and reference video if you have them. The AI first maps attack, defense, and continuous state, then action boards, character and scene assets, a first-shot confirm, and shot-by-shot generation.
records.outputContentDesc: An action-director analysis, a continuity-state sheet, character and scene assets, weapon and magic-implement designs, a full fight storyboard, 30-60 seconds of shot video, fight sound or a full sound design, and the finished fight passage.

records.name: Music MV
records.intro: A video locked to the beat, the lip sync, and the story.
records.useScenario: Original-song MVs, an artist's own work, rap MVs, emotional music films, single promotion, virtual-singer performance videos, and cases where the music exists but the visuals do not.
records.useGuide: Upload the music. The system reads BPM, structure, lyrics, and the timeline, then designs characters, scenes, and the storyboard. After the visual plan is confirmed, it generates assets and keyframes. Performance shots are lip-synced through OmniHuman. Narrative shots use Seedance 2.0. The edit follows the original timeline.
records.outputContentDesc: Music structure and a lyric timeline, an MV concept and storyboard, character and scene visual assets, keyframes for each shot, lip-synced performance shots, narrative video shots, and a finished MV aligned to the original track.

records.name: JP Anime Drama Lab
records.intro: Turn a youth romance into a realistic Japanese anime drama.
records.useScenario: Youth romance, missed chances and reunions, city stories, school feelings, and dialogue-dense comic dramas.
records.useGuide: Enter a spark, synopsis, or full script, and upload character or scene references if you have them. After language, characters, and scenes are confirmed, boards and the anime short are generated automatically.
records.outputContentDesc: Character designs, scene references, a full storyboard, multi-camera comic-drama video, and the finished film.

records.name: Chinese-Style Short
records.intro: Plot-free Chinese-style music shorts, built on atmosphere.
records.useScenario: Turn Chinese-style instrumental music, classical mood copy, moonlit courtyards, or cloud-sea towers into pure atmosphere films or music visualization. No plot, no character relationships, and no romance or fan-work expression.
records.useGuide: Provide a theme, copy, or instrumental track, plus the desired mood, setting, duration, and optional references. Default is 9:16 vertical. Figures are only static or lightly moving images. The brief, storyboard, and generated assets each wait for confirmation.
records.outputContentDesc: An intent read, a plot-free mood-progression storyboard, Chinese-style frames in one palette, and a 9:16 HD atmosphere film using fades and light transitions. No text, watermark, or character interaction.

records.name: Pets at Work
records.intro: Shoot a cute pet as a real office worker's day.
records.useScenario: Pet accounts, workplace-joke shorts, content for people who relate to office life, and serialized vlogs.
records.useGuide: Upload 1-2 pet photos. After the anthropomorphic look and plot are confirmed, a daily vlog is generated: waking, commuting, work, lunch, and leaving the office.
records.outputContentDesc: An anthropomorphic pet character design, a vlog storyboard, realistic handheld shorts, ambience, and the finished film.

records.name: Kitty Theater
records.intro: Let cats perform human life and emotional stories.
records.useScenario: Cute-pet shorts, emotional stories, nostalgic content, and serialized pet-account programming.
records.useGuide: Choose an emotion and a life situation, and upload a cat reference if you have one. After plot and storyboard are confirmed, an anthropomorphic short is generated.
records.outputContentDesc: A cat character design, a story storyboard, a realistic anthropomorphic short, background music, and a series end-card hook.

records.name: Soft 3D Cute Anime
records.intro: A soft, warm, story-rich 3D short from a character idea.
records.useScenario: Cute-pet animation, small fantasy creatures, gentle children's stories, healing shorts, cute social content, and short stories for an IP character.
records.useGuide: Enter an idea or upload a reference, and choose a creative direction. After the story and lead look are confirmed, scenes, props, boards, and video are generated step by step.
records.outputContentDesc: An original character design, scene and prop assets, a full story storyboard, first and last frames, shot-by-shot animation, BGM, and the finished healing film.

records.name: Jurassic Park Short
records.intro: Shoot a modern adventure as a 1990s prehistoric thriller.
records.useScenario: Dinosaur expeditions, rainforest chases, prehistoric spectacle, desperate escapes, and retro adventure drama.
records.useGuide: Enter a story or upload character and scene references, confirm plot and visual direction, generate character, dinosaur, and scene assets, design the storyboard, then generate and composite the short.
records.outputContentDesc: Character and dinosaur designs, scene assets, a full storyboard, video clips, score and sound effects, and the finished adventure short.

records.name: Story Soundscape
records.intro: From script to cut, with each character's voice consistent.
records.useScenario: Story shorts, micro-dramas, character dialogue, and ad dramas where several characters keep speaking and the same voice must hold across shots.
records.useGuide: Upload a script directly, or enter a theme and let the AI write it. After script and storyboard are confirmed, build a look and a voice reference for each character, then generate video shot by shot.
records.outputContentDesc: A full script, a storyboard script, character and scene assets, character voice anchors, shot-by-shot drama video, narration and BGM, and the finished film.

records.name: Abstract Visual TVC
records.intro: Brand benefits as motifs, material change, surreal space.
records.useScenario: For technology, fragrance, finance, art, fashion, and brand-image work, and for concepts that are hard to shoot directly, such as speed, freedom, energy, and connection. Prefer it when metaphor and visual spectacle should give the product a premium feel.
records.useGuide: Provide product or brand materials, then a few keywords or the feeling you want to convey. Choose a concept direction you like.
records.outputContentDesc: A memorable visual concept, image assets, a shot list, and the finished commercial.

records.name: Action Previs Board
records.intro: Turn an action idea into continuous storyboards and previs.
records.useScenario: For previs of fights, chases, and stunts, turning an action idea or an existing board into a visible motion plan.
records.useGuide: Provide an action idea or existing previs boards, and optionally character turnarounds and scene references. The Skill reads action beats, camera blocking, and joins between boards, then generates continuous action video board by board.
records.outputContentDesc: An action previs board, character and scene assets, board-by-board action previs, and a finished continuous edit.

records.name: Fashion Visuals
records.intro: From garment design to a model's performance, in one film.
records.useScenario: Apparel e-commerce, designer presentations, new-season lookbooks, runway concept films, street-style outfit videos, and fashion graduation shows.
records.useGuide: Upload a garment image or describe the design, generate a flat technical drawing, confirm the model and the styled look, choose a presentation setting, generate a six-panel storyboard, and output a 15-second fashion film.
records.outputContentDesc: A three-view garment flat, a model outfit card, scene visuals, a six-panel storyboard, video-generation prompts, and a finished 15-second fashion film.

records.name: East Asian Art Film
records.intro: Restrained shots and daily detail, for an East Asian mood.
records.useScenario: For art-film shorts about loneliness, longing, parting, waiting, and letting go.
records.useGuide: Enter a mood, a scene, or a short line of copy, or upload character and scene references. Emotional arc and shot rhythm are designed automatically.
records.outputContentDesc: An emotional visual plan, character and scene designs, a full storyboard, shot video, and the finished film.

data.text:
MiniMax H3 RH Enhanced Limited-Time Free Access for Members

Every day from 21:00 to 10:00 the following day, MiniMax H3 offers members an exclusive nighttime creation period. Members can use full-reference generation for free during this limited-time period, turning a single image into a character, scene, and complete video.

Non-members are charged at the standard rates:

  • 480p: RMB 0.10 per second
  • 768p: RMB 0.20 per second
  • 1080p: RMB 0.42 per second

For members, creation costs drop to zero for a limited time every night.

data.text:
MiniMax H3 RH Enhanced: An Omni-Modal Video Creation Model

MiniMax H3 RH Enhanced is an omni-modal generative model designed for video creation. It understands text, images, videos, and audio, and combines different types of media into a unified video creation context.

It supports:

  • Multimodal input: text, images, videos, and audio can be used together
  • First-and-last-frame control: specify the opening and ending frames to generate continuous motion and camera transitions
  • Full-reference generation: reference characters, scenes, actions, camera movement, visual style, and sound
  • Up to 1080p resolution
  • Video generation up to 15 seconds
  • Native stereo audio
  • Multiple aspect ratios for landscape, portrait, and comic-drama content

MiniMax H3 is suitable for comic short dramas, character-driven storytelling, action sequences, product advertising, e-commerce showcases, brand campaigns, and visual concept films.
data.label: MiniMax H3 RH Enhanced: An Omni-Modal Video Creation Model
data.title: MiniMax H3 RH Enhanced: An Omni-Modal Video Creation Model

summary:

This is a 15-second original cinematic graphic-novel sequence. During a violent snowstorm, the energy tower is already severely unstable. The original heavy-duty engineering machine stands ahead of the tower in the intended fall direction and uses a rescue cable to pull the tower down toward the front-right of the frame before rapidly retreating.

Throughout the video, the tower must fall only toward the front-right. It must never return to an upright position, rise upward, float, or move in the opposite direction.

Use @Image 1 for the machine design, @Image 2 for the energy tower and environment, @Image 3 for the pulling action and force direction, and @Image 4 for the overall visual style. Use pure image full-reference generation. Do not use video references, audio references, first-frame alignment, or last-frame alignment.

detailed_description:

The video uses a premium cinematic graphic-novel style with realistic mechanical materials, violent weather, and a strong collapsing impact. The spatial relationship must remain clear: the machine is in the right foreground, the energy tower is in the left background, and the rescue cable runs from the rear shoulder area of the machine to the top of the tower.

The machine moves toward the front-right of the frame, and the top of the tower is pulled toward the front-right as well. The tower must fall only in the same direction as the machine's movement. Do not show the tower being lifted, restored, reversed, or suspended in the air.

[Shot 1] A wide aerial shot opens over the stormy coastline. The energy tower is visibly unstable and already leaning toward the lower-right foreground. Cracks spread around its base, and a broken industrial bridge crosses the coast. The machine enters from the left background and quickly moves ahead of the tower toward the front-right. The camera pushes forward and slightly to the right, clearly showing that the machine is positioned in the intended collapse direction.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a low side angle. The machine occupies the right foreground while the energy tower remains in the left background. The machine moves rapidly toward the front-right, pulling a thick rescue cable connected from its rear shoulder area to the top of the tower. The cable becomes fully taut. The tower top begins to shift toward the front-right, while the bridge and tower structure vibrate violently.

[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts rapidly between the tightened cable and the tower base. The machine continues pulling toward the front-right. The left side of the tower base breaks first, followed by several supporting beams. The tower top clearly moves toward the front-right and begins falling in the same direction as the machine. Follow the tower's downward movement with the camera. Do not allow the tower to rise or return to an upright position.

[Shot 4] At 00:10.500, the camera switches to a wide rear-side angle. The machine is already ahead of the collapse and continues retreating toward the front-right. Behind it, the entire energy tower falls toward the front-right across the broken industrial bridge. Metal structures slam into the ground, snow and sea spray explode outward, and the storm fills the frame. The machine remains intact and is never crushed by the falling tower.

[Shot 5] At 00:13.500, the energy tower has completely collapsed across the broken bridge in the background. The machine stops in the foreground and turns its head back toward the fallen structure. Behind it are the collapsed tower, rough waves, flying snow, and fading storm clouds. End on a strong composition showing the machine in the foreground and the fallen energy tower behind it.

overall_soundscape:

Violent wind, crashing waves, heavy mechanical footsteps, hydraulic joints, tightening rescue cables, breaking metal supports, bridge vibration, the collapse of the energy tower, heavy metallic impacts, and sea spray. No dialogue and no human voices.

non_diegetic_music:

A cinematic score with low strings, deep percussion, and tense brass. The rhythm accelerates as the machine begins pulling the cable. The music reaches a powerful climax when the tower base breaks and the tower falls. After the tower hits the bridge, the music suddenly drops away, leaving only wind and waves.

params.prompt:
【Content】

A lighthearted, comforting milk tea commercial with a subtle touch of magical realism.

During the daytime, at a quiet city street corner, a cup of iced milk tea is calmly floating in mid-air at approximately chest height.

Inside the transparent cup, the milk tea, ice cubes, and rich creamy foam are clearly visible. Natural condensation droplets cover the outside of the cup, and a straw is already inserted.

The milk tea remains perfectly stable while floating — no spinning, drifting, or unnecessary movement — as if it were a small, completely natural miracle in this world.

A young woman @Image 2 hurriedly runs in from the left side of the street and heads toward the corner on the right, clearly looking like she is rushing somewhere.

As she quickly passes the street corner, she suddenly notices the cup of milk tea floating in the air.

She immediately slows down and stops in surprise. Because of her momentum, her body naturally leans slightly forward for a moment. She then turns back toward the milk tea with a genuine, realistic expression of surprise, as if trying to confirm whether she really saw what she thinks she saw.

She slowly walks closer and cautiously reaches out to touch the cup with one hand.

After realizing that the floating milk tea is actually real, she naturally takes it out of the air and holds it in her hand.

She takes her first sip.

At the exact moment she drinks the milk tea, the overall atmosphere of the scene begins to change naturally.

The street, which originally feels slightly dim, desaturated, rushed, and emotionally heavy, gradually becomes filled with warm, bright sunlight.

The overall exposure gently increases, the colors become clearer and more vibrant, and the leaves, pavement, buildings, and surrounding environment are softly illuminated by natural sunlight.

Do not use a sudden white flash or exaggerated magical effects.

The transformation should feel subtle and emotional, as if her mood has suddenly improved — the light, colors, and atmosphere simply become warmer, brighter, clearer, and more breathable.

After taking a few sips, the woman visibly relaxes.

She gives a soft, natural smile and no longer runs.

Holding the milk tea in her hand, she continues walking down the street at an easy, relaxed pace, occasionally taking another sip.

Her calm, leisurely state should create a clear contrast with the hurried, stressed energy at the beginning.

For the ending, let the milk tea naturally become the visual focus, emphasizing its icy, refreshing, soothing quality and the feeling of instantly slowing down and relaxing.

【Camera / Cinematography】

Vertical 9:16.

A combination of realistic smartphone photography and subtle cinematic commercial aesthetics.

Use a slightly elevated street-corner camera angle at the beginning, similar to the reference composition, allowing the frame to clearly capture the street, the approaching woman, and the floating milk tea at the same time.

Keep the camera completely fixed throughout the entire video.

No camera movement, no panning, no tracking, and no unnecessary reframing.

The realism should come from the woman's natural body movement, realistic momentum, believable interaction with the floating cup, and the gradual environmental lighting change.

【Music / Sound】

At the beginning, use a slightly faster-paced urban ambience with subtle hurried footsteps to communicate that the woman is rushing.

When she notices the floating milk tea, briefly reduce or pause the music and add a very soft, subtle whimsical sound cue.

When she drinks through the straw, include clear and pleasant sounds of ice cubes gently clinking inside the cup, along with a soft sipping sound.

From the first sip onward, transition the music into a light, bright, warm, and comforting melody.

Blend it naturally with soft city ambience and a gentle breeze.

Avoid making the overall tone overly dreamy or fantastical.

The emotional concept should feel more like:

“A busy day suddenly slows down after one sip of milk tea.”

data.prompt:
【内容】

一支轻松、治愈、有一点奇幻感的奶茶创意广告。

白天的城市街角，一杯冰奶茶静静悬浮在半空中，距离地面大约胸口高度。透明杯中能看到奶茶、冰块和丰富的奶泡，杯壁带有自然冷凝水珠，吸管插在杯中。奶茶悬浮得非常稳定自然，不旋转、不漂移，像这个世界里一个小小的奇迹。

一位年轻女生@图片2 从街道左侧急匆匆跑到转角右边，看起来像正在赶时间。她快步跑经过街角时，突然注意到悬浮在空中的奶茶。

她立刻放慢脚步，惊讶地停下来，身体因为惯性稍微向前晃一下，然后回头看向奶茶，露出自然、真实的惊讶表情，像是在确认自己是不是看错了。

她慢慢靠近，用手试探性地碰了一下杯子，确认奶茶真的存在后，自然地将悬浮的奶茶拿下来。

她喝下第一口奶茶。

就在喝下去的一瞬间，整个画面的氛围发生自然变化：原本稍微偏暗、低饱和、匆忙压抑的街道逐渐被温暖明亮的阳光填满，整体曝光轻轻提升，颜色变得更加清透鲜活，树叶和环境被柔和阳光照亮。

不要突然闪白，不要夸张魔法特效，而是像心情突然变好一样，光线、色彩和空气感自然地慢慢变得明亮。

女生喝完后明显放松下来，轻轻笑一下，不再奔跑。她拿着奶茶，以悠闲轻松的步伐继续沿街道向前走，偶尔再喝一口，和刚开始急匆匆的状态形成明显反差。

结尾让奶茶自然成为视觉中心，突出冰凉、清爽、让人瞬间放松的感觉。

【镜头 / 摄影】

竖屏 9:16，真实手机摄影与轻电影广告质感结合。

开场使用稍高机位的街角视角，类似参考画面的俯拍角度，可以同时看到街道路面、跑来的女生和悬浮奶茶。

始终固定机位

【配乐 / 声音】

开场使用稍快节奏的城市环境音与轻微急促脚步声，表现女生正在赶时间。

女生看到悬浮奶茶时，音乐短暂停顿或减弱，加入一个很轻的奇妙提示音。

吸管喝下奶茶时加入清晰、舒服的冰块碰撞声和吸饮声。

从第一口开始，音乐切换成轻快、明亮、治愈的旋律，同时加入柔和城市环境声与自然风声。

整体不要过度梦幻，更像是**“忙碌的一天，因为一口奶茶突然慢了下来”**的感觉。

params.prompt:
【Content】

The video begins inside a car from a strict first-person POV.

A man opens the car door and steps out. The camera moves naturally with his body as he exits the vehicle and enters a lively city street in daylight. Pedestrians are walking, chatting, drinking coffee, checking their phones, while cars move normally along the road. The entire city feels active, realistic, and full of natural motion.

The man lowers his gaze and raises one hand. In his palm is an elegant vintage metal pocket watch with intricate, mysterious mechanical details.

The first-person camera moves into a close-up of the pocket watch.

His thumb gently presses the button on top of the watch.

At the exact moment the button is pressed, all surrounding sound suddenly disappears and the entire world instantly freezes in time.

Only the man in first-person POV remains able to move freely.

Do not use explosions, particles, magical beams, glowing energy, or exaggerated visual effects. The time-stop effect should be conveyed only through the sudden disappearance of ambient sound and the complete freezing of the environment.

The man calmly walks forward into the frozen street.

The first-person camera moves naturally through the motionless crowd, passing several frozen pedestrians.

He approaches the first young woman, @Image 1. She is completely frozen while looking at her phone. The camera moves closer. The man extends his right hand and gently pinches one of her cheeks with two fingers. Her soft cheek shows a subtle, realistic compression and deformation, but the woman herself remains completely frozen in time.

He then quickly but naturally walks toward the second woman, @Image 2. She is holding a coffee and looking ahead, with her hair frozen in midair as if caught by the wind. From the first-person POV, the man gently pinches her opposite cheek, then releases it.

The man continues walking forward naturally. Everyone around him remains completely frozen.

He raises the pocket watch again.

The first-person camera moves into another close-up. His thumb presses the button once more.

The world instantly resumes normal motion.

【Camera / Cinematography】

Strict first-person POV throughout the entire video, with a realistic human viewpoint. The visual feeling can resemble a GoPro or body-mounted POV, but the camera height should stay close to natural eye level rather than chest level.

The entire sequence should feel like one continuous take.

Realistic modern city street in daylight, natural lighting, cinematic live-action photography, realistic skin texture, and believable human proportions.

While walking, the first-person camera should have only very subtle and natural vertical movement caused by human footsteps. Avoid excessive shaking or unstable motion.

Both hands must always follow correct first-person human perspective. The arms should naturally extend upward from the bottom of the frame. Do not generate extra hands, distorted fingers, disconnected arms, or floating limbs.

After time is stopped, everything in the environment must remain absolutely motionless except for the protagonist's hands and the movement of the POV camera. All pedestrians, vehicles, clothing, hair, tree leaves, and surrounding objects must remain completely frozen.

During the cheek-pinching moments, the cheek should show only soft, subtle, realistic skin deformation. After the fingers release, the cheek naturally returns to its original shape. Avoid exaggerated or cartoon-like deformation.

The pacing should feel fast, smooth, playful, and slightly fantastical, while maintaining a realistic live-action cinematic quality.

The man must physically walk between locations in continuous real-time movement. Do not teleport, jump instantly between people, skip spatial movement, or use sudden position changes.

data.prompt:
【

视频开始于汽车内部，第一人称视角。

男生打开车门，从车里走下来，镜头随着身体自然移动，来到白天热闹的城市街道。街上有行人正在走路、聊天、喝咖啡、看手机，车辆正常行驶，整个城市充满真实动态。

男生低头抬起一只手，掌心里拿着一枚精致、复古、带有神秘机械结构的金属怀表。


第一人称近距离看向怀表。

拇指轻轻按下怀表顶部按钮。

按钮被按下的一瞬间，周围所有声音突然消失，世界瞬间完全静止。

只有第一人称视角的男生仍然可以自由移动。

不要使用爆炸、粒子、魔法光束等夸张特效，只通过声音突然消失、环境瞬间冻结表现时间停止。


男生从容地走进完全静止的街道。

第一人称镜头自然向前移动，经过几个被冻结的人。

他走到第一位年轻女生面前@Image 1 。女生保持正在看手机的姿势完全静止。镜头靠近，男生伸出右手，用两根手指轻轻捏一下她的脸颊，柔软的脸颊产生自然轻微形变，但女生本人仍然完全保持时间静止状态。

随后迅速走向第二位女生@Image 2 。她正拿着咖啡目视前方，头发停在被风吹起的瞬间。男生从第一人称视角轻轻捏一下她另一侧脸颊，然后松手。




男生自然往前走，周围人仍旧冻结，他重新举起怀表。

第一人称视角特写，拇指再次按下按钮。

世界瞬间恢复运行。

【镜头 / 摄影】

严格第一人称 POV，真实人体视角，仿 GoPro / chest-level human POV，但镜头位置应接近真实眼睛高度。

一镜到底感。

真实城市街头，白天自然光，电影级真人摄影，真实皮肤质感，真实人物比例。

第一人称走路时有非常轻微、自然的人体步伐起伏，但不要剧烈晃动。

双手必须始终符合第一人称人体透视，手臂从画面下方自然伸出，不要出现第三只手、畸形手指或漂浮手臂。

时间停止之后，除男主角双手和镜头移动之外，背景中的所有人物、车辆、衣服、头发、树叶和物体必须保持绝对静止。

捏脸时脸颊只产生真实、柔软、轻微的皮肤形变，松手后恢复正常，不要夸张卡通变形。

整体节奏快速、流畅、有趣，具有轻微奇幻电影感，但保持真人实拍质感。男生移动不要瞬移

【Content】
Vertical 9:16 fun screenshot-challenge short video.

In the center of the frame, a dog faces the camera directly, with its head and body staying in a fixed position throughout. The dog should remain mostly still, with only slight natural expressions such as subtle blinking, gently sticking out its tongue, or slightly looking upward. It should not walk, turn around, or change position.

Above the dog’s head, different wig overlay images drop vertically downward one by one from the top of the frame. The wigs should look like separate realistic human wigs with a transparent PNG overlay effect.

Each wig should move downward along the exact same vertical path and completely exit the frame.

As soon as one wig leaves the frame, the next one should immediately appear from the top and quickly fall down. Show 4 completely different hairstyles in sequence, such as short hair, long curly hair, twin ponytails, and an afro.

The background must remain completely fixed. The camera must also remain fixed, with no zoom, pan, tilt, or cuts. The dog’s position, scale, and facial structure must stay fully consistent throughout.

Key point: the wigs are only fast-moving foreground overlay stickers, not real hair growing on the dog’s head. The overlays must not block the dog’s face. All wig overlays should fall at the same speed. Do not make them animated stickers, and do not let them pause or stay in place.

The character’s movements should fully reference @Video 1.

Only modify the “visual styling changes” from the original video:

At the beginning, the character wears plush sleepwear and matching pajama pants while performing the corresponding movements from @Video 1.

At the timing point of the first outfit change in the original video, instantly replace the plush sleepwear and pajama pants with a uniform.

After the uniform appears, the uniform, shoes, hairstyle, accessories, and the character’s overall appearance must all remain permanently locked and unchanged.

After that, continue to strictly recreate the original movements and rhythm of @Video 1.

Whenever a suitable beat-point hand motion or finger-snap motion appears in @Video 1, each beat point should only trigger a stocking change:

plain white stockings → black thigh-high stockings → black fishnet stockings → white lace stockings → black designer stockings → light gray stockings.

The stocking changes should happen only on the legs. The character’s movements themselves must continue smoothly according to @Video 1, without pausing, redoing the motion, or suddenly changing pose because of the stocking change.

Throughout the entire video, the character should maintain the same facing direction and movement logic as in @Video 1, while naturally looking at the camera with a stable gaze that does not wander. Keep smiling, do not lip-sync, and blink naturally about once during the whole video.

Vertical 9:16, realistic photography style, fixed camera, one continuous take, shallow depth of field, and a bright, clean beverage shop environment. The cup should always remain centered on the table, and the cup shape, angle, and position on both the left and right sides must stay consistent. The lighting should be bright and clear, emphasizing the layered liquid, ice cubes, condensation droplets, and topping details.

The finished drink on the right side must remain unchanged.

The left side should only show the making process.

No text, logos, or watermarks.

No exaggerated special effects.

Do not let people block the main subject.

The final finished drink must be highly consistent with the input drink image.

params.prompt:
【Content】

A fast-paced short dance video featuring a girl with a sharp, instant outfit-change moment.

At the beginning of the video, a girl stands facing the camera in a bedroom, wearing a loose blue pajama set. She first performs a short dance sequence built around stylized “pulling at the clothes” movements. She dances naturally to the rhythm, then uses her left hand to pull the pajama fabric outward, switches to the other side, and pulls again. These movements should feel like intentional choreography that sets up the transformation later. This stage should not look like ordinary undressing. Instead, it should feel playful, slightly theatrical, and full of anticipation, like a signature dance move before a stage transformation.

Then, on a clear musical beat, she performs a sharp and clean instant outfit-change action. Continuing naturally from the previous pulling motion, she quickly pulls the loose blue pajamas away and throws them to the side, like a fast costume reveal in a stage performance. Visually, it should feel like a clear, impactful, and precise “instant switch.”

Once the pajamas are thrown aside, she immediately reveals the black camisole outfit underneath, as if she has suddenly switched into a full stage-performance look. She then continues dancing while facing the camera, with more confidence, stronger expression, and a more theatrical performance quality, while still keeping all movements natural and fluid, like a highly polished short-form transformation dance video.

Throughout the entire video, the character should maintain an attractive and slightly alluring on-camera presence. Her gaze should stay naturally locked on the camera, soft but expressive, with a subtle teasing quality. She may occasionally narrow her eyes slightly, keep her lips naturally parted, and show only a faint, almost imperceptible smile. Avoid exaggerated laughter or blank expressions. Her overall expression should feel confident, relaxed, and charming, like a fashionable short-form video creator naturally showing her charisma while dancing in front of the camera. Keep her gaze stable. Do not let her eyes wander, drift, become cross-eyed, or suddenly turn stiff or change expressions too frequently.

Key points:

The first half is a choreographed “pulling at the clothes” dance sequence.

The second half is an instant outfit change timed precisely to the beat.

It should feel like a “stage transformation.”

It should NOT look like slowly taking off clothes.

It should NOT look like casually changing clothes.

It should feel like a sharp, accurate, high-impact quick reveal from a live stage performance.

【Camera / Cinematography】

Vertical short-form video style. The character should remain facing the camera throughout the entire video. Use mainly full-body or medium-full-body framing so that the upper-body movements and the entire outfit-change action are clearly visible.

Fixed camera position. Keep the overall frame clean, with the character always remaining the visual center.

【Effect Requirements】

The outfit change must appear as an instant stage-style transformation, using one beat-synchronized movement to complete the switch from:

blue pajama look → black camisole stage look.

The transition must be smooth and seamless. It must not look like ordinary undressing or a slow, dragging clothing-removal process.

The motion of throwing the pajamas aside should be clean, sharp, smooth, and visually easy to understand. It can feel almost like a magic-trick costume reveal.

Keep the character’s body movement natural, hands anatomically correct, facial expression confident and lively, and gaze consistently directed toward the camera.

No character drifting, no body deformation, no fabric clipping, and do not turn the transformation into an awkward slow-motion undressing sequence.

Reduce image noise and random grain.

data.prompt:
【内容】

一支节奏鲜明、带有瞬间换装感的女生跳舞短视频。

视频开头，一位女生面朝镜头站在卧室里，穿着一套宽松的蓝色睡衣。她先跳一段带有“扯衣服”设计感的舞蹈动作：一开始自然跟着节奏跳舞，然后用左手向外扯一下睡衣，再换另一边再扯一下，动作像在为后面的变装做铺垫。这个阶段不是普通脱衣服，而是像舞蹈编排中的标志性动作，带一点俏皮、舞台预备感和张力。

随后在一个明显的音乐卡点上，女生完成一个干脆利落的瞬间换装动作：宽松蓝色睡衣被她延续之前扯衣服的舞蹈的动作顺势快速扯下并甩到一边，像舞台表演里的快速变装一样，视觉上是一个清晰、有冲击力、很利索的“瞬间切换”。

睡衣甩开后，女生立刻露出里面的黑色吊带造型，整体状态像突然切换成舞台妆 / 表演状态。随后继续面朝镜头跳舞，动作更自信、更有表现力、更有舞台感，但依然自然流畅，像一支完成度很高的短视频变装舞蹈。人物全程保持有吸引力、带一点魅惑感的镜头表现。眼神始终自然锁定镜头，目光柔和但有张力，带轻微挑逗感；偶尔微微眯眼、嘴唇自然微张，嘴角带很轻的若有若无的笑意，不要夸张大笑，不要呆滞表情。整体表情自信、松弛、迷人，像时尚短视频博主面对镜头跳舞时自然释放魅力。眼神稳定，不要眼球乱飘，不要斗鸡眼，不要表情突然僵硬或频繁变化。

重点是：

前半段是“扯衣服”的舞蹈设计

后半段是卡点瞬间换装

要有“舞台变身”的感觉

不是慢慢脱衣服

不是日常换衣服

而是像舞台演出中那种利落、准确、带冲击力的快速 reveal

【镜头 / 摄影】

竖屏短视频风格，人物全程始终面朝镜头，以全身或中全身构图为主，清楚看到上半身动作和换装过程。固定机位，整体画面干净，人物始终是视觉中心。


【效果要求】

换装必须表现成一种瞬间舞台变装效果，像通过一个卡点动作完成“睡衣造型 → 黑色吊带舞台造型”的切换。

动作衔接要丝滑，不能像普通脱衣服，也不能拖泥带水。

睡衣被甩开的动作要干净、利落、顺畅，视觉逻辑清晰，可以像变魔术一样。

人物肢体自然，手部正确，表情自信生动，眼神稳定看向镜头。

不要人物漂移，不要肢体变形，不要布料穿模，不要把换装做成奇怪的慢动作脱衣过程。降低画面噪点

params.prompt:
【Content】

A fashionable travel transformation short video.

The video opens on a pure white minimalist background. A young woman in a casual short-sleeve outfit stands full-body in the center of the frame. Her face should reference @Image 2. She looks down naturally while using her phone, with relaxed and effortless body language. As she operates the phone, a floating red location pin appears above her head, and she is then visually brought into a digital map world.

She then sequentially “arrives” in different cities: Seoul → Tokyo → Shanghai → London. Each time she reaches a new city, the background transforms into a corresponding 3D map scene with representative landmarks of that city, and the girl simultaneously changes seamlessly into an outfit that matches the local style. The outfit styling should reference @Image 1, the composition and framing should reference @Image 3, and the background references are: Seoul @图片5 ， Tokyo @图片6 , Shanghai @图片4 , London @Image 7.

At the opening transition and at every city transition, the camera moves in a complete 360° clockwise orbit around the subject, starting from the front, moving to the side, then the back, then the other side, and finally returning to the front. The camera should maintain a relatively fixed distance and height from the subject, like a photographer walking in a circle around her. The subject must remain centered in the frame at all times, and the horizon should stay level and stable. Camera orbit around the subject. After the orbit ends, the girl should still remain stably centered in the frame. Her face, hairstyle, and body proportions must remain consistent; only the outfit and city background should have changed. At the same time, the text inside the UI should update to the corresponding city name (Seoul → Tokyo → Shanghai → London).

The character must remain the same girl throughout the entire video—same identity, no face changes, no duplication, no drifting, and no sudden disappearance. After arriving in each new city, she only performs simple natural presentation gestures, such as lightly turning around, looking at the camera, adjusting her clothes, or casually standing with her phone. The overall feeling should be relaxed, stylish, and like a social-media fashion post showing “instant city-and-outfit switching.”

【Camera】

TikTok short-video style, vertical 9:16, primarily full-body framing. The girl must remain clearly visible at all times and stay centered in the frame. Her body proportions and position should remain stable and continuous, without drifting, scaling, distortion, or disappearance during transitions.

The opening starts with a minimal pure white background, then naturally enters a visual system similar to Google Maps / a 3D city map. The frame should include clean and realistic map interface elements, such as a top search bar, city names in English, location pins, map zoom controls, and the effect of the city space gradually unfolding. The overall interface should remain clean, modern, and believable, without excessive UI clutter.

Each city transition should use an orbiting camera transition centered on the girl to complete both the background replacement and the outfit transformation. The camera moves in a fast arc or full 360° orbit around the person. The subject must remain locked in the center of the frame, while the camera height and her relative size in the frame stay roughly consistent. Through camera orbit, background parallax, and motion blur, the current city should transition naturally into the next city, and the outfit change should happen seamlessly during the orbit.

【Content】

A 12-second premium orange-scented body lotion commercial. A young woman has fair, natural, healthy-looking skin. The visuals mainly focus on close-up body details, the creamy texture of the body lotion, and fresh oranges.

**0–1.2s | Dispensing the Body Lotion**

Extreme macro close-up. The woman presses the pump of the body lotion bottle, dispensing a smooth, milky-white lotion naturally into her palm. Clearly showcase the silky, creamy, refined texture of the product.

**1.2–2.5s | Applying to the Arm**

Close-up of her fair-skinned arm. She gently spreads the body lotion across her arm with her palm using a few simple, natural strokes. The lotion gradually absorbs into the skin, leaving a soft, healthy, natural sheen.

**2.5–3.5s | Applying to the Neck**

Close-up of the neck and shoulder area. She gently applies a small amount of body lotion around the neck and collarbone area with smooth, natural movements.

**3.5–4.5s | Water Flowing Over a Fresh Orange**

Extreme macro close-up of a whole fresh orange. Clear water naturally flows across the textured orange peel, with droplets rolling over its uneven surface. Soft side and back lighting illuminates the vivid orange peel, emphasizing a fresh, clean, refreshing citrus feeling.

**4.5–6s | Peeling the Orange**

Two hands hold the orange. The thumbs naturally break into the peel and slowly peel it open. Macro photography captures the peel splitting and curling back, the white pith, and the intact orange segments gradually being revealed. The movement should feel realistic and natural.

**6–7.2s | Applying to the Hands**

The woman applies a small amount of body lotion to the backs of her hands and palms, gently rubbing her hands together until the lotion gradually absorbs.

**7.2–8.5s | Applying to the Legs**

Close-up of the lower leg. While seated, the woman naturally applies body lotion to her calf, spreading it gently along the skin with her palm. Focus on the fine creamy texture of the lotion and the fair, natural appearance of the skin.

**8.5–10s | Applying to the Back**

Close-up of the shoulder and upper back. The woman naturally reaches behind and evenly applies body lotion across her shoulder and upper back. Soft side lighting gently outlines the contours of the skin and its natural glow.

**10–12s | Product Hero Shot**

The orange-scented body lotion bottle is positioned in the center of the frame. Around it are naturally arranged whole oranges, a partially peeled orange, and several curled pieces of orange peel.

A few fresh water droplets remain on the product bottle and orange peel.

The camera slowly pushes in as soft light gently sweeps across the bottle, ending on a clean, refined, premium product hero shot.

【Camera / Cinematography】

Vertical 9:16. Premium body-care TV commercial, realistic live-action photography.

**premium body care commercial / macro skincare photography / sensory citrus commercial**

Use extensive macro photography and close-up body shots, smoothly transitioning between lotion → fair skin → fresh orange → skin → product.

The woman’s skin should appear fair, luminous, natural, and healthy, while preserving realistic skin details such as subtle pores, fine texture, and natural variations in skin tone.

The body lotion should have a realistic, rich, smooth, creamy texture.

The overall color palette is creamy white, warm orange, light apricot, and soft natural skin tones.

Use soft natural side lighting and backlighting, bright and clean exposure, shallow depth of field, and a subtle bloom glow.

Pay special attention to capturing:

* the texture of the lotion as it is dispensed
* the lotion spreading naturally across the skin
* water flowing over the textured orange peel
* the detailed texture of the orange peel as it is opened
* the white citrus pith and fresh orange segments
* realistic skin texture and natural highlights

The overall visual atmosphere should feel fresh, warm, soft, moisturizing, and natural, evoking the refreshing citrus aroma released when peeling open a freshly picked orange.

【Music / Sound Design】

Light, refreshing, warm, premium skincare-commercial background music with no vocals.

The visual transitions should subtly sync with the rhythm of the music.

Add delicate ASMR sound details:

pump pressing sound, soft lotion dispensing sound, gentle hand-rubbing and lotion-spreading sounds, clear water flowing over the orange peel, and the crisp natural sound of fresh orange peel being opened.
